name: Rápido y jarioso
notes: Hector 10-28: 250 to 185, the point of interest; judge the bark: wrap in tin foil with butter and BBQ or vinegar sauce, or keep going; back on until 203. Cook done: the pit drops to 150, the rest to 160-155, then the hold.

pit.name: Rápido
pit.tell: Rápido y jarioso: pit at 250 the whole way.

meat.name: Point of interest
meat.tell: {meat}°F, the point of interest: check the bark. Ready: tin foil with butter and BBQ or vinegar sauce, back on until 203. Not yet: keep going.

meat.name: Done
meat.tell: {meat}°F: done. Take it off to rest and tap Cook done: the pit drops to 150 for the hold.
